meta.title: Control balance sheet and duty to liquidate (Ch. 25 ABL)
meta.description: Translated 1:1 from control-balance-sheet-website-v2.bpmn. Node IDs are identical to that BPMN file's gateway/end-event IDs, and every true/false target below follows its sequenceFlow sourceRef/targetRef exactly.
meta.intro: This tool walks you through the rules on control balance sheets and the duty to liquidate in Chapter 25 of the Swedish Companies Act (aktiebolagslagen). Based on your answers, it shows which step of the process applies to the company and what follows from it.
meta.audience: Board members of Swedish limited companies (aktiebolag) whose equity may have fallen below half of the registered share capital, and the accountants, auditors and students who work with these rules.
meta.disclaimer: This tool gives general guidance only and is not legal advice. For a specific case, consult a lawyer or an accountant.

Q1_1.question: Does the board have reason to assume that equity, calculated under Ch. 25 Sec. 14, is below half of the registered share capital?
Q1_1.citation: Ch. 25 Sec. 13 para. 1 pt. 1 Companies Act

Q1_2.question: Has enforcement under Ch. 4 Enforcement Code shown that the company lacks assets to pay the claim in full?
Q1_2.citation: Ch. 25 Sec. 13 para. 1 pt. 2 Companies Act

End_1.label: No duty to prepare a control balance sheet
End_1.description: No duty to prepare a control balance sheet; no liquidation process under Ch. 25 Secs. 13-17 Companies Act.

Q2_1.question: Has the board prepared a control balance sheet under Ch. 25 Sec. 14 (ordinary balance sheet with the permitted adjustments of assets, liabilities, provisions and untaxed reserves)?
Q2_1.supportiveText: A "No" here is a formal defect.

Liab_1.label: Possible personal liability
Liab_1.description: Control balance sheet missing – duty under Ch. 25 Secs. 13-14 Companies Act not fulfilled. Personal liability is outside the scope of this assessment (Ch. 25 Secs. 18-20a Companies Act).

Q2_2.question: Has the control balance sheet been reviewed by the company's auditor, or does the company have no auditor?
Q2_2.citation: Ch. 25 Sec. 13 and Ch. 1 Sec. 12 b Companies Act
Q2_2.supportiveText: Either answer continues to the next question; a "No" is simply noted as a defect (auditor review missing).

Q2_3.question: Is equity under Ch. 25 Sec. 14 (adjusted assets minus adjusted liabilities, with untaxed reserves split into equity and deferred tax) below half of the registered share capital?

End_2.label: No critical capital deficiency
End_2.description: No critical capital deficiency; no duty to hold a control meeting under Ch. 25 Sec. 15 Companies Act.

Q3_1.question: Has the board, as soon as possible, issued notice of the first control meeting?
Q3_1.supportiveText: A "No" here is a defect (first control meeting not convened).

Liab_2.label: Possible personal liability
Liab_2.description: First control meeting not convened. Personal liability is outside the scope of this assessment (Ch. 25 Secs. 18-20a Companies Act).

Q3_2.question: Was the first control meeting held with the control balance sheet and the auditor's statement presented?
Q3_2.supportiveText: Either answer continues to the next question; a "No" is simply noted as a defect (meeting not held correctly).

Q3_3.question: Did the first control meeting resolve that the company shall go into liquidation?

End_3.label: Voluntary liquidation follows
End_3.description: The company goes into voluntary liquidation (Ch. 25 Sec. 1 Companies Act); no compulsory liquidation under Ch. 25 Sec. 17 Companies Act.

Q3_4.question: Did the control balance sheet at the first meeting show equity at least equal to the registered share capital?

End_R1.label: No second control meeting required
End_R1.description: No second control meeting required (Ch. 25 Sec. 16 para. 1 Companies Act).

Q4_1a.question: Has the second control meeting been held?

Q4_1b.question: Was it held within 8 months of the first meeting, or, after a company reorganisation during that period, within 2 months after the reorganisation ended?
Q4_1b.supportiveText: A "No" means a ground for liquidation under Sec. 17 para. 1 pt. 1 already exists.

Q4_1c.question: Has the deadline (8 months, or 2 months after a company reorganisation ended) passed?
Q4_1c.supportiveText: A "Yes" means a ground for liquidation under Sec. 17 para. 1 pt. 1 already exists.

End_P.label: Deadline not yet passed
End_P.description: Deadline not yet passed – the second control meeting must still be held (Ch. 25 Sec. 16 Companies Act).

Q4_2.question: Has the board prepared a new control balance sheet under Ch. 25 Sec. 14 before the second control meeting?
Q4_2.supportiveText: A "No" (defect: no new control balance sheet) still proceeds to whether the second meeting resolved liquidation.

Q4_3.question: Has the new control balance sheet been reviewed by the company's auditor, or does the company have no auditor?
Q4_3.citation: Ch. 25 Sec. 16 para. 2 and Sec. 17 para. 1 pt. 2 Companies Act
Q4_3.supportiveText: A "No" (defect: auditor review missing) still proceeds to whether the second meeting resolved liquidation.

Q4_4.question: Is equity under Ch. 25 Sec. 14, at the time of the second control meeting, at least equal to the registered share capital?
Q4_4.citation: Ch. 25 Sec. 17 para. 1 pt. 2 Companies Act

Q4_5.question: Was the control balance sheet showing full capital cover presented at the second control meeting?
Q4_5.citation: Ch. 25 Sec. 16 para. 2 and Sec. 17 para. 1 pt. 2 Companies Act

End_4.label: No duty to liquidate
End_4.description: No duty to liquidate due to capital deficiency; no compulsory liquidation under Ch. 25 Sec. 17 Companies Act.

Q4_6.question: Did the second control meeting resolve that the company shall go into liquidation?
Q4_6.citation: Ch. 25 Sec. 17 para. 1 pt. 2 Companies Act
Q4_6.supportiveText: A "No" means a ground for liquidation under Sec. 17 para. 1 pt. 2 already exists.

End_5.label: Voluntary liquidation follows
End_5.description: The company goes into voluntary liquidation; no compulsory liquidation under Ch. 25 Sec. 17 Companies Act.

Q5_1.question: Ground for liquidation under Ch. 25 Sec. 17 para. 1 Companies Act: has an application been filed with the district court — by the board within 2 weeks, or by a board member, the MD, an auditor or a shareholder?

Liab_4.label: Possible personal liability
Liab_4.description: No application filed – the board must apply within 2 weeks. Personal liability is outside the scope of this assessment (Ch. 25 Secs. 18-20a Companies Act).

Q5_2.question: During the court proceedings, has a control balance sheet showing equity at least equal to the registered share capital been reviewed by the auditor and presented at a general meeting?

End_7.label: No liquidation order issued
End_7.description: The district court shall not order liquidation; no compulsory liquidation (Ch. 25 Sec. 17 para. 3 Companies Act).

Q5_3.question: Does the ground for liquidation under Ch. 25 Sec. 17 para. 1 Companies Act still exist (no second meeting in time, or second meeting without full capital cover or a reviewed control balance sheet and without a liquidation resolution)?

End_8.label: District court orders liquidation
End_8.description: The district court shall order the company into liquidation, effective immediately (Ch. 25 Sec. 17 Companies Act).

End_9.label: No compulsory liquidation
End_9.description: No compulsory liquidation (Ch. 25 Sec. 17 Companies Act).
